titleStmt.title: A Time Series is Worth 64 Words

abstract.p: Long-term time series forecasting is a critical task across many domains.

div.head: 1 Introduction
div.p: Time series are ubiquitous in real-world applications.
We propose PatchTST, a model based on patching and channel independence.

div.head: 2 Method
div.p: The model splits time series into patches.

div.head: 3 Experiments
div.p: We evaluate on eight real-world datasets.
